behaviours.quote: reducing healing received by $801534s2% for enemies inside for $801534d.
behaviours.observe_source: Command: Blight 801534 (server DBC set) Effect[1] SPELL_EFFECT_PERSISTENT_AREA_AURA, aura 118 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HEALING_PCT, BasePoints -61 + 1 = -60 ($801534s2 = 60), on enemies within 10 yd of the Decaying Colossus, DurationIndex 18 (20000 ms). Both phases raise a Colossus (500989; Summoning Adept 92123 for 3 Life Force), which goes to the selected dummy 3 yd away; an enemy player (race 2, PvP on both sides) at the caster's position puts Rejuvenation 9840 on itself (a fixed HoT: BasePoints 77 + 1 = 78 every 3000 ms for 15000 ms, 5 ticks; periodic heals do not crit here, the enemy holds no spell power) and the heal totals are read 15500 ms after its cast, when the HoT has run out (in the treatment the HoT starts 1000 ms after the Command, inside the ground's 20000 ms). Before (control): no Command, 5 x 78 = 390. After: the same HoT inside the ground: 78 x (1 - 0.60) = 31.2 per tick, 31 as an integer heal, 5 x 31 = 155 more, cumulative 545 (judged to the rounding). The enemy_ground entry reads 801534 on the enemy player after the Command, not before. A 45-point tick (Rejuvenation 8070, diag2) read 17 for 45 x 0.4 = 18: the float product falls just below 18 and truncates, so a tick whose 40% is not an integer is used.

behaviours.name: Crypt Plague (ticks every 2 sec)
behaviours.quote: Deals ${$m1+0+$SP*0.06} Plague Damage every $t sec for $d,
behaviours.observe_source: As the tick_sp0 entry, counting the 570131 ticks of one application: 4 by 9500 ms and 5 by 10500 ms after the cast: the fifth tick falls in (9500, 10500] ms, $t = 2 sec x 5 inside the G-19 band (5% of 10 s) on both sides. Control (before): no cast, 0. The entry names Crypt Plague 570131, whose tooltip carries the quote (the 92121 ledger row describes the same aura). Game time (ADR 0501, integration of batch M): the 4-tick reading (nominal 9500 ms) and the 5-tick reading are judged at their game time after the cast, both inside the G-19 band 9500..10500 ms around the fifth tick (5 x $t = 10 s); the 5-tick reading's nominal time moves from 10500 to 10400 ms (expiry_wait_ms 900) so the 10-17 ms of game time each wait step adds (ADR 0485) keeps it inside the band.

behaviours.name: Crypt Plague (lasts 10 sec)
behaviours.quote: Deals ${$m1+0+$SP*0.06} Plague Damage every $t sec for $d,
behaviours.observe_source: Crypt Plague 570131 DurationIndex 1 ($d = 10000 ms): one real cast at the dummy; the aura is on it 9700 ms after the cast and gone 10300 ms after it: the end lies in (9700, 10300] ms, inside the G-19 band (9500..10500 ms) on both sides. Control (before): no cast, absent. The entry names Crypt Plague 570131, whose tooltip carries the quote (the 92121 ledger row describes the same aura). Game time (ADR 0501, integration of batch M): the held reading (nominal 9700 ms) and the gone reading (nominal 10300 ms) are judged at their game time after the cast, both inside the G-19 band 9500..10500 ms (5% of $d = 10000 ms); the 10-17 ms of game time per wait step (ADR 0485) no longer enters the bracket.

behaviours.name: Crypt Plague (a second application does not refresh)
behaviours.quote: Additional applications do not refresh duration.
behaviours.observe_source: Crypt Plague 570131 (DurationIndex 1, 10000 ms; tooltip: additional applications do not refresh duration), applied by the game path: with Crypt Plague 92121 learned in both phases a Lichfrost 501978 hit adds 2 stacks through Plague() (AscensionNecromancerEvents.cpp:106-107; a fresh aura, then SetStackAmount for later ones, AscensionNecromancer.cpp:276-291). Lichfrost: 2500 ms cast, then travel. Before (control): one Lichfrost, the aura is on the dummy 10000 ms after the cast starts (applied about 2600 ms in, so held until about 12600 ms). After: a first Lichfrost, 4000 ms, a second Lichfrost (a second application), and 10000 ms after the second cast starts (14000 ms after the first) the aura is gone; a refresh would hold it until about 16600 ms. 13000 ms between the phases let the control's aura expire. A direct 570131 cast (pair4 diagnostic) re-applies the aura through the stock path and refreshes it, so it is not the claim's path. Game time (ADR 0501, integration of batch M): the gone reading is judged at its game time after the second Lichfrost cast starts, inside 9100..12000 ms: after the first application's expiry (cast 4000 ms earlier, 2500 ms cast time, $d = 10000 ms: about 8500-8600 ms, plus the 500 ms G-19 band) and before a refreshed aura could end (2500 ms cast time + 10000 ms, less the band).

behaviours.name: Diabolical (Crypt Swarm channel)
behaviours.quote: to deal $707133s1% increased damage per stack.
behaviours.observe_source: Diabolical 704723 known throughout. Crypt Swarm 501886 (level 54 rank, Effect[0] aura 227 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE, 3000 ms, a tick every 500 ms) casts its tick 800343 with its own value, 57 + int(0.24 x 6) = 58 at level 60. The damage hook multiplies a tick by 1 + 0.1 x the 707133 stacks (AscensionNecromancerContracts.cpp:416-417), the crit (forced, precondition) then x1.5, and each tick removes one stack (AscensionNecromancerEvents.cpp:108-117). 823764 on the caster removes partial resists. Expected from the tooltip ($707133s1 = 10% per stack), the forced crit x1.5 and one integer amount per hit: control phase, the channel's own cast gives 1 stack: floor(58 x 1.1 x 1.5) = 95, then five ticks of 87: total 530. After 31000 ms, fourteen Commands and the channel give 15 stacks: ticks at 15, 14, 13, 12, 11, 10 stacks: floor(87 x 2.5, 2.4, 2.3, 2.2, 2.1, 2.0) = 217 + 208 + 200 + 191 + 182 + 174 = 1172, total 1702. A bonus of 9% or 11% per stack gives other sums.

behaviours.expected_source: The tooltip states the direction, not a factor. The damage hook multiplies a periodic tick of the Harvest Plague family 500968 by 2 - target health percent / 100 (AscensionNecromancerContracts.cpp:418-419): the control dummy (50000000 health, about 100%) takes the tick x 1.0, the treatment dummy held at 50% before every cast (harness set_health_pct, precondition fixture) x 1.5. behaviours.name: Necromancy (Life Force)
behaviours.quote: Allows you to summon Undead minions using Life Force.
behaviours.observe_source: Necromancy 804360 (Effect[0] dummied, AscensionNecromancerContracts.cpp:111) describes the minion system. Scale() (AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp:279-332) runs at the summon and every 1000 ms (UpdateAI event 1): attack power = (caster Intellect + max(Frost, Shadow spell power)) x 0.4 x the minion's Life Force cost; the minion's 805015 Effect[1] magic damage done = (Intellect + spell power) x 0.2 x cost; resistances = the caster's x 0.4 (armor x 0.35); melee, ranged and spell hit chance copied; base spell crit = the caster's Frost spell crit; cast speed and swing interval follow the caster's cast speed. Life Force 525004 on the caster holds one stack per free Life Force (Sync, AscensionNecromancer.cpp:190-200: Capacity() - Used()); with 804360 learned, 2 free before a raise (control) and 1 after one Raise: Ghoul 500971 (Cost 1): the summon is paid in Life Force.

behaviours.quote: in exchange for $/20;m2 Runic Power.
behaviours.observe_source: Runic Harvest 562213 (rank 4 of 562210) Effect[1] aura 64 PERIODIC_MANA_LEECH, BasePoints 79 + 1 = 80 ($m2), Amplitude 1000, DurationIndex 1 (10000 ms). AscensionNecromancerContracts.cpp:317-322 removes Effect[0], makes Effect[1] a 1000 ms periodic dummy on the caster; aura_ascension_necromancer_lifecycle::Tick (AscensionNecromancerAuras.cpp:166-178) takes min(80, mana) from each raised minion (Minions(player, true)) within 40 yd and energizes the caster for half the total in Runic Power (80 mana -> 40 units = 4 Runic Power, $/20;m2). Ghouls 50073 have mana (Scale(), AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp: level x 30 + Intellect x 5 x cost). The reference character has no haste, so the hasted period (AttributesEx5 0x2000) is the stated 1000 ms. A Ghoul is raised in each phase; no cast (control): no energize. After the cast, two Ghouls for 10 ticks: 2 x 10 x 40 = 800 Runic Power units (4 Runic Power per minion per tick).

behaviours.observe_source: Runic Harvest 562213 (rank 4 of 562210) Effect[1] aura 64 PERIODIC_MANA_LEECH, BasePoints 79 + 1 = 80 ($m2), Amplitude 1000, DurationIndex 1 (10000 ms). AscensionNecromancerContracts.cpp:317-322 removes Effect[0], makes Effect[1] a 1000 ms periodic dummy on the caster; aura_ascension_necromancer_lifecycle::Tick (AscensionNecromancerAuras.cpp:166-178) takes min(80, mana) from each raised minion (Minions(player, true)) within 40 yd and energizes the caster for half the total in Runic Power (80 mana -> 40 units = 4 Runic Power, $/20;m2). Ghouls 50073 have mana (Scale(), AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp: level x 30 + Intellect x 5 x cost). The reference character has no haste, so the hasted period (AttributesEx5 0x2000) is the stated 1000 ms. 562213 is cast in both phases: with no minion (control) no Runic Power, with one Ghoul raised first 10 x 40 = 400.

behaviours.name: Raise: Banshee (Command drain)
behaviours.quote: and deals Frost damage equal to the mana drained
behaviours.observe_source: An enemy player (a Necromancer, race 2, 2803 maximum mana, full) is the target: the dummy has no mana. Six candidates within 8 yd of the caster for the 4 additional, one at 13 yd that must stay unhit.

behaviours.name: Raise: Ghoul (auto attack heal, minion healing modelled)
behaviours.quote: health to you.
behaviours.observe_source: Regression of the 707000 coefficient row (ADR 0322): the tooltip value ${$707000m1+$707000ppl1+(($INT*0.504)+($SP*0.504))*0.07} read with the measured stats, then Ghoul Passive Healing 805290 Effect[1] (aura 136 -30% healing done, on every Ghoul from IsSummonedBy) modelled on the Ghoul's heal; the -30% itself is owner question Q-a1-6. Control: no Ghoul, no 707000 heal.

behaviours.name: Raise: Ghoul (auto attack heal, more Intellect)
behaviours.quote: health to you.
behaviours.observe_source: Second arm of the 707000 coefficient regression: Arcane Brilliance 43002 (Effect[0] SPELL_AURA_MOD_STAT +60 Intellect) is set on the caster before its stats are measured (a precondition fixture; the claim is the heal's Intellect term), so the model reads the higher Intellect and the heal rises by 0.504 x 0.07 = 0.03528 per point before the -30%. Without the coefficient row both arms read the same heal.

The control phase has no Ghoul: 0. behaviours.name: Raise: Ghoul (Command damage)
behaviours.quote: Plague damage,
behaviours.observe_source: Command: Undead 504868 (the Command every non-stationary minion answers, Responds() in AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp; its Effect[1] keeps the dummy as the explicit target) orders every Ghoul in 60 yd (Order()); each Ghoul casts 801514 at the target (DoAction, case 50073): Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE on enemies within 10 yd of the Ghoul, Plague (SchoolMask 40). behaviours.name: Chilling Presence
behaviours.quote: Increases critical strike chance of all party and raid members by $s1%.

AuraEffect::HandleModCritPercent adds the amount to the melee, ranged and spell crit percentages of every unit the area aura reaches; the grouped, non-caster ally's melee crit percentage (PLAYER_CRIT_PERCENTAGE after Player::UpdateCritPercentage(BASE_ATTACK), melee_crit_chance_refreshed: the plain field read 0 on the fresh ally before the learn, pair prove-2) is read before and after the caster learns 300958 and must rise by 3 points (relation additive: a crit chance takes percent points, not a factor).

behaviours.name: March of the Dead (explode on reaching an enemy)
behaviours.quote: Beckon the restless dead to rise and march forward.
behaviours.observe_source: A walker 523032 explodes once an enemy is within 2.5 yd of it or when it reaches its aim point (UpdateAI, AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp:875-880; MovementInform :591-592): event 3 casts March of the Dead 707010 on itself (:829-835), Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE around the walker (TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ENEMY, 5 yd), and despawns. No cast (control): no 707010 hit; one cast: six 707010 hits from walkers 523032 on the dummy, one per risen walker (the six of the data row; they spawn within 2.5 yd of the dummy at 3 yd and explode at once, so an owned_creature_count read 300 ms after the cast already found none, pair prove-6). The same hits carry the claim that they explode when they reach an enemy. Expected from the tooltip only (mentor method rule, 2026-11-13): the tooltip states no walker count, so the claim is judged as presence (at least one explosion hit); the six hits of the code's data row are not the expectation.

behaviours.name: Flesh Symbiosis (armor)
behaviours.quote: Each Abomination or Decaying Colossus active now increases your total Armor and magic resistance by $805017s2%
behaviours.observe_source: 301207 Effect[0] aura 101 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE_PCT; its contract sets MiscValue to every school (AscensionNecromancerContracts.cpp:275-280) and aura_ascension_necromancer_lifecycle sets the amount to 30 x the count of Abominations 50068 and Decaying Colossi 50115 (AscensionNecromancerAuras.cpp:66-67, $805017s2 = 30), recalculated every 500 ms (AscensionNecromancer.cpp:409-411). Both phases raise an Abomination (500335, 3 Life Force; Summoning Adept 92123 learned for a capacity of 3; the second raise replaces the first): the caster's armor without 301207 (control) and 1.3 times it with 301207 learned between the phases.

behaviours.name: Flesh Symbiosis (magic resistance)
behaviours.quote: Each Abomination or Decaying Colossus active now increases your total Armor and magic resistance by $805017s2%
behaviours.observe_source: As the armor entry, the caster's Frost resistance with Frost Resistance 24448 (aura 22, +90 Frost, a precondition fixture by harness set_aura in both phases, the reference character has none): 90 without 301207, 116 with it, judged exactly. G-26 emulation: 805017 aura 101 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE_PCT +30 sets TOTAL_PCT to GetTotalAuraMultiplierByMiscMask, AddPct(1.0f, 30) = 1.3f (Unit.cpp:7071-7080, Util.h:58-61); Player::UpdateResistances computes value = 90.0f, value *= 1.3f = 116.99999f in float32 and stores int32(value) = 116 (StatSystem.cpp:343-365): 90 x 1.3 = 117 truncated one below by the engine's float, the known engine rounding.

behaviours.name: Flesh Symbiosis (no gain without an Abomination)
behaviours.quote: Each Abomination or Decaying Colossus active now increases your total Armor and magic resistance by $805017s2%
behaviours.observe_source: The count gate: without an Abomination or Colossus raised, learning 301207 leaves the armor unchanged (the amount is 30 x 0). A Lich Form 500981 cast stands in for the raise in both phases (no armor effect).

behaviours.name: Flesh Symbiosis (regeneration over one period)

behaviours.observe_source: The contract makes 301207 Effect[1] a 5000 ms periodic dummy ($t2) and its handler adds 2% of the maximum health ($805017s3) per Abomination or Colossus (player->ModifyHealth(CountPctFromMaxHealth(2) x Count), AscensionNecromancerAuras.cpp:197-201). 301207 is learned at the start; the caster is held at 50% of a 10000 health fixture (caster_health_pct, ADR 0423; natural regeneration off) and Lich Form 500981 is cast as the timed trigger, then health is read 5000 ms later: one tick in any 5000 ms window. Control phase without an Abomination: unchanged (1.0); with one raised: 5200 / 5000 = 1.04 (2% of 10000 per tick).

behaviours.name: Flesh Symbiosis (regeneration over two periods)
behaviours.quote: and causes you to periodically regenerate $805017s3% maximum health every $t2 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: As the one-period entry, read 10000 ms after the trigger: two ticks (5400 / 5000 = 1.08), so the period is 5000 ms within one tick per window.

behaviours.name: Command: Bonefreeze (area)
behaviours.quote: Command your Skeletal Mages to freeze enemies at target location
behaviours.radius_reason: DoAction casts Bonefreeze 504845 at every valid enemy within 8 yd of the Command's target (Nearby(target, 8.0f), AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp:664-669); the three additional dummies stand 2, 4 and 6 yd from the primary. No dummy beyond: 504845 is itself an 8 yd area at its target (TARGET_UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY, EffectRadiusIndex 14; the contract that would make it single-target is dead for family 21, observation O-b3b-1), so it reaches about 16 yd from the primary (the dummy at 13 yd was frozen, diagnostic pair prove-10)
behaviours.observe_source: One Skeletal Mage is raised, then Command: Bonefreeze at the selected primary dummy (select_primary, ADR 0423); 504845 (cast by the Mage, read on each dummy whatever its caster) on every additional dummy right after the Command, before the Mage's first 801513 splash. Control: before 504489 is learned the Command is refused, no freeze.

behaviours.radius_reason: placement only: one additional dummy 7.5 yd from the primary (radius x 1/2), inside the 8 yd freeze around the target and outside the 6 yd of the Mage's 801513 splash ($801513a1), so no damage reaches it
behaviours.observe_source: As the area entry, read 38500 ms after the Command: the Mage's splash hits only within 6 yd of its target (diagnostic pair prove-10: the dummies 2 to 6 yd away took a hit and lost the freeze), so the dummy 7.5 yd away takes no damage and is still frozen, the no-damage control of ADR 0421 and the creature duration's lower bound against 40000 ms.

behaviours.expected_source: Lichfrost 501978 Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE Frost, 569 to 597 (mean 583) plus Frost spell power x 0.86989416 (NecromancerCoefficients row {501978, 0, 0.86989416, 16}). Control arm at Frost spell power 0, treatment with Increase Frost Dam 132 24666 (+132 Frost) set before each cast: (583 + 132 x 0.86989416) / 583 = 1.1969 on the mean non-critical hit; 823764 in both arms removes partial resists. A coefficient of 0.65 would give 1.147 and 1.08 give 1.245, both outside the band at +19.7%.

behaviours.name: Heartchill (haste on a successful interrupt)
behaviours.quote: Successfully interrupting a spell also reduces their movement speed and haste by $803677s1% for $803677d.
behaviours.observe_source: Tooltip: 'reduces their movement speed and haste by $803677s1%' ($803677s1 = 80): the same sentence takes 80% off the movement speed (rate x0.2, the slowed entry), so haste, an attack rate, is read as x0.2 too: the dummy's attack time 2000 ms becomes 10000 ms (expected from the tooltip only, mentor method rule 2026-11-13). The server applies 803677 Effect[1] aura 192 SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_RANGED_HASTE -80, which Unit::ApplyAttackTimePercentMod turns into attack time x1.8 (3600 ms, route-1); the earlier x1.8 expectation was the engine's convention (Templar Sacred Swing entry), not the tooltip. The dummy channels Evocation 12051 before Heartchill (target_casts_before, ADR 0426), the interrupt casts 803677 at it (AscensionNecromancerAbilities.cpp:239-245). Control: the uncast phase, the dummy's base attack time.
